experience.summary: Builds applied AI systems for real-time vehicle tracking, aerial drone intelligence, and agricultural commodity forecasting.
achievements: Architected AGRIIQ, an end-to-end vehicle gateway system combining a two-stage YOLO11 + ByteTrack pipeline with a PyTorch EfficientNet vision pipeline; reduced GPU compute overhead by approximately 83% through trajectory subsampling while maintaining real-time tracking.
Developed an aerial drone intelligence pipeline using PyTorch, DeepForest AI, and Rasterio for automated tree-crown segmentation, with PyODM orthomosaic stitching.

Trained LightGBM time-series regression models for four-week agricultural commodity price forecasts with median and percentile confidence intervals; built a four-tier fallback mechanism to provide 100% prediction coverage.

experience.summary: Built AI-enabled workflow products and distributed backend services, spanning invoice processing and sales automation.
achievements: Designed a fault-tolerant, distributed invoice-processing system handling 10,000+ documents per day using asynchronous workers, Redis-backed queues, and horizontal scaling.

Designed and built a full-stack AI-powered sales automation platform integrating REST APIs across Zoho CRM, Microsoft Outlook, and Google Calendar to automate scheduling and client-management workflows.
Containerized Python enterprise backend services with Docker and integrated LLM-based components through production-oriented APIs to improve deployment repeatability and service reliability.

experience.summary: Built data workflows and NLP classification capabilities with the data science team.
achievements: Built and deployed data workflows in Dataiku, integrating Python scripts to cluster frequent-flyer data.
Built a custom RoBERTa-based classifier that achieved an F1 score of 92.3.
Collaborated with senior data scientists to analyze outputs, prepare reports, and communicate findings for stakeholder review.

projects.name: Autonomous Multi-Agent Red Team Testing Service (DREAM)
projects.tagline: Multi-agent framework for automated adversarial testing and LLM failure analysis
highlights: Designed a multi-agent architecture with planner, attacker, evaluator, and target roles to generate, execute, and investigate adversarial test cases against LLM systems.
Built an evaluation harness that triaged more than 5,000 automated test executions into 120+ distinct failure categories without human labeling.
Achieved approximately 42% coverage of known failure taxonomies in project evaluation.
The broader research design includes contextualized guided policy search, FAISS-based retrieval, and cross-environment adversarial knowledge-graph concepts.
projects.metrics: 5,000+ automated test executions · 120+ failure categories · ~42% failure-taxonomy coverage

projects.name: PharmaGene-RAG: Pharmacogenomic Decision Support
projects.tagline: Evidence-grounded RAG designed to reduce unsupported medical explanations
highlights: Co-authored and defended a research project focused on mitigating LLM hallucinations in medicine.
Built a hybrid RAG system combining knowledge graphs, vector search, and metadata filtering; reported approximately 70% improvement in evidence-grounded explanation accuracy.
Implemented retrieval grounding and citation enforcement, reducing unsupported clinical claims by approximately 60% versus baseline models.
Designed a local deployable inference pipeline with under 3.5-second end-to-end latency.
projects.metrics: ~70% improvement in evidence-grounded explanation accuracy · ~60% fewer unsupported clinical claims · <3.5s latency

projects.name: Automated Legacy Code Migration Agent
projects.tagline: Multi-agent code migration with automated semantic-equivalence verification
highlights: Designed a planner, migrator, and verifier pipeline to translate legacy code into a modern equivalent.
Used static analysis to locate migration targets and automated test execution to verify semantic equivalence.
Migrated 78% of a 340-file Python 2-to-3 codebase with zero test regressions across a 1,200-test suite.
projects.metrics: 78% of a 340-file codebase migrated · zero regressions across 1,200 tests

projects.name: AGRIIQ: Real-Time AI Vehicle Gateway
projects.tagline: Two-stage detection and tracking with an efficient vision pipeline
highlights: Combined YOLO11 and ByteTrack with a PyTorch EfficientNet vision pipeline for real-time vehicle tracking.
Reduced GPU compute overhead by approximately 83% through trajectory subsampling.

projects.name: Aerial Drone Tree-Crown Intelligence
projects.tagline: Geospatial AI pipeline for automated tree-crown segmentation and orthomosaic generation
highlights: Developed an aerial drone imagery pipeline for automated tree-crown segmentation.
Integrated PyTorch, DeepForest AI, Rasterio, and PyODM orthomosaic stitching.

projects.name: Agricultural Commodity Price Forecasting
projects.tagline: Four-week time-series forecasts with confidence intervals and resilient fallbacks
highlights: Trained LightGBM time-series regression models for four-week agricultural commodity price forecasts.
Produced median and percentile confidence intervals and engineered a four-tier fallback mechanism for 100% prediction coverage.
projects.metrics: Four-week forecast horizon · 100% prediction coverage with fallback tiers

projects.name: Invoice_AI: Distributed Invoice Processing & Accounting Integration
projects.tagline: Built asynchronous invoice automation pipeline with OCR, AI validation, and QuickBooks integration
highlights: Built a production-oriented invoice automation system using FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, and Redis, with asynchronous RQ workers decoupling API ingestion from OCR and other compute-intensive processing.
Designed a distributed processing architecture supporting approximately 10,000 invoices per day and sub-second API response times for ingestion.
Implemented OCR and rule-based parsing with a Gemini parsing fallback when extraction confidence falls below 0.85.
Integrated QuickBooks through its REST API and defined operational API flows for uploads, invoice listing, dashboard statistics, and retrying failed jobs.
Containerized services with Docker and environment-based configuration to support repeatable deployment.
projects.metrics: 10,000+ invoices/day · sub-second API response times · asynchronous Redis/RQ processing
projects.organization: Efforts IT Solutions Ltd internship project

projects.name: Cross-Environment Adversarial Knowledge Graph (CE-AKG)
projects.tagline: Belief-state tracking and relationship mapping for multi-step adversarial scenarios
highlights: Models the evolving context of adversarial interactions across disconnected digital environments.
Uses recursive information fusion to represent entities, credentials, tokens, and potential pivot pathways.
Includes an interactive force-directed graph visualization concept for inspecting relationships and clusters.

projects.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Live Profile Server
highlights: Profile design describes JSON-RPC 2.0 and server-sent events (SSE) endpoints for AI-agent integrations.
Includes concepts for candidate screening, skill verification, and rubric-based job-fit evaluation.
Includes a protocol-inspection interface for viewing payloads and latency diagnostics.

projects.name: AI-Powered Sales Co-worker & Workflow Automation
projects.tagline: Full-stack sales assistant for CRM, email, calendar, and client-management workflows
highlights: Designed and built a full-stack AI-powered sales automation platform using backend services and REST API integrations.
Integrated workflows across Zoho CRM, Microsoft Outlook, and Google Calendar to automate scheduling and client management and reduce manual workflow overhead.
The broader Sales Co-worker project context also explored Zoho Books and Yeastar PBX integrations; these are kept as integration scope rather than claimed as completed integrations.

about: Fadil Anwar is a Computer Science and Engineering graduate from SRM Institute of Science and Technology with applied AI internship experience at Emirates, Efforts IT Solutions Ltd, and Dexian India. His work spans distributed invoice automation, AI-powered sales workflow automation, multi-agent LLM evaluation, evidence-grounded RAG, real-time computer vision, drone-based geospatial intelligence, and agricultural commodity forecasting. He is interested in building practical AI and software systems with measurable outcomes, robust backend architecture, and clear industry value.
